question: Should exec/process/node-host returned tool results redact secret-shaped output by default, or must this PR add an explicit raw-output reveal path before merge?
rationale: The patch is narrow and proven, but it changes a security and compatibility boundary for returned command output that automated review should not decide alone.

options.title: Accept default returned-output redaction
options.body: Land this patch as the default security boundary for exec/process/node-host tool results and accept that secret-shaped output may no longer be byte-exact.

options.title: Require explicit raw-output reveal
options.body: Ask for a maintainer-approved opt-in reveal path before merge so exact output remains available only through a deliberate control.

options.title: Pause for broader redaction policy
options.body: Keep this PR open while maintainers decide generic redaction-marker or config semantics in related redaction issues before changing this boundary.

recommendation.title: Accept default returned-output redaction
recommendation.body: Land this patch as the default security boundary for exec/process/node-host tool results and accept that secret-shaped output may no longer be byte-exact.

likelyOwner.reason: This person has recent exec/process history and was directly asked in the PR discussion for the maintainer/security decision.
